281. (Currently amended) A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and at least two adhesive layers, the tool comprising first and second layers, a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on the first layer, a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on the second layer, the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer configured to be cured to each other, the tool has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, and a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are [[in registration with]] __aligned with__ the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer, __and wherein the medial section comprises a fiber reinforced plastic.__

282. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises [[a metal]] __a metal honeycomb structure__.

283. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 282 wherein the [[metal is a honeycomb structure]] __medial section further comprises the fiber reinforced plastic bonded to the metal honeycomb structure__.

284. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section is a composite material __including a honeycomb portion and fiber reinforced plastic on opposite sides of the honeycomb portion__.

285. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including a [[weld]] ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, __wherein the ring is bonded to the first and second layers by adhesive.__

286. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the [[weld ring is bonded to the medial section]] __ring is bonded to the medial section by adhesive__.

287. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also [[welded]] __directly affixed__ to an outer perimeter of the [[weld]] ring.

288. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the [[weld]] ring is continuous.

289. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the [[weld]] ring is segmented, __and wherein each segment of the ring corresponds to fewer than all of the plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments__.

290. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring, __and wherein the inner ring is bonded to the medial section by adhesive__.

291. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 290 wherein the inner ring includes [[central opening]] __a central opening__.

293. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including a [[weld]] ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the [[weld]] ring, __wherein the ring is bonded to the first and second layers by adhesive, and wherein the ring comprises a plurality of circumferentially spaced ring segments__.

294. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 293 wherein the [[weld]] ring is [[continuous]] __discontinuous__.

295. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 293 wherein the [[weld]] ring is segmented, __and wherein each segment of the ring supports a respective one of the plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments__.
